Slice-level (docs/product.md 11): Slices 3 (capture/transcript ingest), 4 (distillation), 5 (personal scope + promotion), 7 (dataset export/adapter) are designed only - no code in apps/ or packages/. No test covers the AC-11 429/Retry-After rate-limit leg; apps/api/src/services/sync-rate-limit.ts, sync-device-registry.ts, github-installation-service.ts have no sibling __tests__ files (only route-level gate tests AC-14/16/17).

Console: graph feature is a deliberate placeholder (graph-canvas.tsx, no WebGL renderer; graph-toolbar controls decorative). Marketing: apps/marketing/src/content/docs-nav.ts has 12 nav entries with href null - only /docs/architecture exists.

cd /Volumes/Projects/ccvps/comemory.io; pkill -f "comemory --data-dir.*enginetest" 2>/dev/null; /Users/falconiere/.claude/comemory/comemory.sh save "Engine sync routes landed in 0.21.0; author absent from HTTP API" "Verified 2026-09-10 against a real comemory serve (0.22.1) and the Falconiere/comemory releases.

1. Sync routes: GET /api/v1/sync/changes, GET /api/v1/sync/manifest and POST /api/v1/sync/import all answer 200 on 0.22.1. Release notes show 'add Slice 2 cloud sync for org workspaces' in v0.21.0, so the routes landed there. GET /sync/status is 404 on the engine - it is Worker-only, matching docs/platform-api.md. comemory.io pins apps/engine/engine-version.txt = 0.18.1, which predates 0.21.0, so deployed sync cannot work until the pin is bumped (issue #51). Latest engine release is 0.23.0.

2. author: memory markdown frontmatter carries an author field (empty string by default) but the HTTP API does not expose it. src/api/list.rs Row on engine main has id/kind/repo/slug/title/tags/quality/created/access_count only, and GET /memories/:id (show) likewise omits it. So console issue #52 (author column, sync AC-12) is BLOCKED on an upstream engine change in Falconiere/comemory - it cannot be implemented in comemory.io alone." --kind discovery --tags "engine,sync,pin,author,blocked" 2>&1 | tail -2

cd /Volumes/Projects/ccvps/comemory.io; /Users/falconiere/.claude/comemory/comemory.sh save "comemory.io repo needs bun installed; local console suite fails on macOS+Node 26" "Working on comemory.io from a clean checkout (2026-09-10): the machine had no bun and no node_modules. Fix: install bun user-locally (curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash, lands in ~/.bun/bin, remove with rm -rf ~/.bun), export PATH=\$HOME/.bun/bin:\$PATH in every shell the Bash tool spawns (it does not persist), then bun install --frozen-lockfile.

bun run check needs TURSO_DATABASE_URL exported (packages/database/drizzle.config.ts reads it at load for knip's check:unused).

Pre-existing local failures, reproduced on main with the branch stashed - not caused by any change: @comemory/console fails 8 tests on macOS with Node v26. (1) src/providers/__tests__/current-workspace-provider.test.tsx, 6 tests: Node 26 defines a global localStorage that shadows jsdom's, so bare localStorage is undefined while window.localStorage works ('ExperimentalWarning: localStorage is not available because --localstorage-file was not provided'). (2) repos-screen and sources-screen live-engine tests: macOS resolves /var to /private/var, so root_path from the engine does not equal the mkdtemp path the test compares against. Both are local-environment artifacts; CI runs ubuntu and is green." --kind discovery --tags "bun,setup,tests,macos,node,flake" 2>&1 | tail -2

cd /Volumes/Projects/ccvps/comemory.io; /Users/falconiere/.claude/comemory/comemory.sh save "Console tests pass locally with --localstorage-file; docs ingest impossible from a Worker" "Two findings from the 2026-09-10 issue sweep.

1. The 8 local @comemory/console failures on Node v26 are fixable per-run: NODE_OPTIONS=--localstorage-file=<path> gives Node's global localStorage a backing file so it stops shadowing jsdom's with undefined, and the suite passes locally. CI (ubuntu) is green either way. The /private vs /var mismatch in the repos and sources live-engine tests is separate and macOS-only.

2. POST /docs could never have worked from the API Worker, which is why issue #50 resolved as removal (PR #68, merged): the engine's only document ingest at 0.23.0 is POST /api/v1/sources with body { path: string[], repo?, strict? } - a filesystem path the engine walks on its own disk, refused with 403 'path escapes every allowed root' unless serve was started with a matching --allow-path, which apps/engine's buildArgv never passes. GET /api/v1/context also carries no documents leg, so docsEnabled gated nothing. The docs_enabled column deliberately stays for now (deploys migrate before the API ships); both corpus reads go through one corpusColumns projection. Follow-up #65 covers the drop, and it is a two-deploy sequence because Drizzle's insert builder emits every column the schema declares - remove the schema field and ship first, then run the migration." --kind discovery --tags "console,tests,node,docs-ingest,engine,worker,migration" 2>&1 | tail -2

cd /Volumes/Projects/ccvps/comemory.io; git checkout -q main && git pull -q --ff-only; git log --oneline -4; /Users/falconiere/.claude/comemory/comemory.sh save "Gate every merge on threads+label+checks, not just the bot label" "Process lesson from the 2026-09-10 issue sweep on comemory.io.

The AI review bot's merge-approved label and its unresolved-thread count disagree: PR #67 carried the label while 17 inline threads were still open, because the authoring agent replied to each finding but never called the GraphQL resolveReviewThread mutation. A reply makes a thread stop looking actionable (its last comment is now the author's) without resolving it, so both the bot and any naive check read it as done.

Merge only behind an explicit three-way gate, in one command so nothing merges on a printed-but-unused count:
  UNRES=$(gh api graphql ... reviewThreads | jq '[.[]|select(.isResolved==false and .isOutdated==false)]|length')
  LBL=$(gh pr view N --json labels -q '[.labels[].name]|join(\",\")')
  FAIL=$(gh pr checks N | awk '\$2!=\"pass\"{print \$1}')
  merge only if UNRES=0, FAIL empty, and LBL contains merge-approved.

Also: a 'review incomplete - provider error' verdict is the reviewer failing, not the code. It sets request-changes with zero findings. Rerun with gh run rerun <run-id> --failed rather than 'fixing' anything." --kind pattern --tags "process,review,merge,github,gate" 2>&1 | tail -2
input.description: Sync main and save merge-gate lesson
